newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index falls 0.079pts to 102.828.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index falls 0.079pts to 102.828.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds fell 0.079 points in Tuesday's trading to 102.828, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio rose 0.112 points to 2.524 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, fell 0.056 points to 99.571, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.439 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 rose 2.487 points to 1,049.784.
